Some titles require their update to be installed before launching.

sigpatches.desc:
Signature patches were not detected on this console.

Installing unofficial software without signature patches

Proceed anyway?

nothing_to_fix.desc:

so there's no digital "update available" flag to fix.

fixed.title: Fixed
fixed.desc:
The update-required flag for this game has been reset
to match what's actually installed digitally.

Note: playing this cartridge again may bring the
prompt back, since that's the console re-detecting
the update on the cartridge itself.

downgrade.title: Downgrade warning
downgrade.desc:
You are installing an older version over a newer one.

Downgrading can cause save data corruption or loss,
and may make the game unplayable.

Proceed with downgrade?

override_warning.title_prefix: This title is currently in use (
override_warning.desc:
This title is currently being used to run the homebrew menu in title
takeover mode. Deleting this app will cause Atmosphere to crash when
returning to the HOME menu.

You may delete the app regardless if you're aware of the risk this poses.

blocked.title: Not running emuMMC
blocked.desc:
You are currently not running Leaflet on your emuMMC.

Installing your game dumps to your sysMMC *will* get your console
*BANNED* if you go online.

If you are aware of the involved risks but wish to disable this check
anyway, you can do so in Settings -> General -> "Warn if not on emuMMC".

Please note that this is *NOT* something you should do, and no support
will be given if anything goes wrong.

undetermined.title: Can't confirm you're on emuMMC
undetermined.desc:
Leaflet could not confirm that you are running on emuMMC.

Installing your game dumps to your sysMMC *will* get your console
*BANNED* if you go online, and Leaflet has no way to confirm that isn't
about to happen.

If you are aware of the involved risks but wish to disable this check
anyway, you can do so in Settings -> General -> "Warn if not on emuMMC".

disable_warn.title: Disable emuMMC check
disable_warn.desc:
This check exists to stop you from accidentally installing your game
dumps to your sysMMC instead of an emuMMC.

Turning this check off means that Leaflet will no longer warn you
about not being booted into your emuMMC.

Press "Continue" to begin a 10 second wait before you can confirm this.
disable_warn.final_desc: You've waited out the countdown. Turn this check off?

blocked.title: Signature patches not detected
blocked.desc:
fs-patch does not appear to be active or its patches were not applied.

fs and ldr must be patched before installing titles.

Ensure fs-patch is installed and has run at least once, then restart
and try again.

Be aware that this check primarily exists so you don't accidentally
install your game dumps on your sysMMC.

If you wish to disable this check despite knowing the involved risks
or if you have a different method of patching FS and LDR, you can
disable this check by going to Settings -> General -> "Disable
fs-patch check".

disable_warn.title: Disable fs-patch check
disable_warn.desc:
Turning this check off means that Leaflet will no longer warn you
about fs-patch not being detected. If you have a different method of
patching FS and LDR, you may disable this check.

Press "Continue" to begin a 10 second wait before you can confirm this.
disable_warn.final_desc: You've waited out the countdown. Turn this check off?
